title: "4 — Pooling calculations"
format:
  html:
    theme: yeti
---

**Goal:** convert between mass and molar concentration, and pool libraries to equal molarity.

## Exercises

- **Q1** A library measures 2 ng/µL with an average fragment length of 400 bp. What is its molar concentration in nM? (Average mass of a base pair ≈ 660 g/mol.)

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="minimal"}
## Hint
nM = (ng/µL × 10⁶) / (660 × fragment length in bp).
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="minimal"}
## Solution
(2 × 10⁶) / (660 × 400) ≈ **7.6 nM**.
:::
